title: Settings Screen & Notification Preferences UI
description: A settings hub screen and a notification preferences screen with live toggles. Users can turn digest emails, mentions, and reply notifications on or off. Changes save immediately via the existing user settings API.

unknowns.description: Does the existing PATCH /api/user/settings endpoint support granular notification fields?
unknowns.resolution: Confirmed: the endpoint accepts arbitrary keys under a 'notifications' object. No schema change needed on the frontend.

tasks.description: Settings hub screen (display name, email read-only, Notifications row)
Optimistic save with revert-on-failure and error toast
Handle initial load state (fetch current preferences on mount)

architecture_decisions.decision: Optimistic UI update on toggle — revert on failure
options_considered: Wait for API response before updating UI
architecture_decisions.rationale: Toggles feel instant. The failure case (revert + toast) is clear. API is fast and reliable.

test_scenarios.description: User opens Settings, taps Notifications, sees all three toggle types
User toggles Digest off — toggle updates immediately, API called, preference persists after restart
API call fails — toggle reverts to previous state, error toast appears
User opens Notification Preferences before API load completes — loading state shown, no toggles visible yet

cost_estimate.note: Approximate. Assumes ~one scope per /work session; includes subagent usage.
